name: NodalRed2x
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Clavia Nord Lead 2x's original firmware (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: a native MPC screen laid out like the Nord's panel, a starter bank plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites in the PRESET menu and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Nord Lead 2x ROM.
